description: This file defines a PHP class 'ADODB2_sybase' which extends 'ADODB_DataDict' providing methods for handling Sybase database interactions, including type mappings, SQL statement generation for schema alterations, and index management within the context of the ADODB PHP database abstraction library.

classes.name: ADODB2_sybase
classes.description: A PHP class providing Sybase-specific database schema management functions, extending the ADODB_DataDict base class.

methods.name: MetaType
methods.description: Converts a database-specific type to an internal code representation, or vice versa, considering the input object or parameters.

methods.name: ActualType
methods.description: Maps internal metadata type codes to the actual Sybase data types.

methods.name: AddColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to add columns to a table.

methods.name: AlterColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to alter existing table columns.

methods.name: DropColumnSQL
methods.description: Generates SQL statements to drop columns from a table.

methods.name: _CreateSuffix
methods.description: Constructs SQL suffix strings for column definitions, including defaults, nullability, auto-increment, and constraints.

methods.name: _IndexSQL
methods.description: Creates SQL statements to manage indexes, including creation and dropping of indexes with specified options.
